input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
input.rationale: Section 4.1's 90-day termination right sits grammatically inside the auto-renewal sentence, so the Company's convenience exit is open to being read as a non-renewal mechanic only; we therefore state the Company's convenience right in a standalone operative sentence at the fallback notice period (90 days). Two further fallback elements fail: (i) HDI's right is not tied to the end of the then-current term (its notice may fix any Termination Date), so HDI could walk away mid-term; and (ii) the Termination Payment triggered by the Company's termination is uncapped (aggregate Net Sales for the preceding twelve months less $800,000, divided by two, payable in eight quarterly instalments) and can far exceed three months of fees. Section 3 ("Fees; Payment", § 3.1) confirms the consideration runs from the Company to HDI as 30% of Net Sales, so the cap on "amounts payable by the Company to HDI under Section 3" is neither nil nor undefined. HDI's 90-day notice period is already met. The preferred 30-day notice and pro-rata refund of prepaid fees are accepted shortfalls given the fallback is reached, and are not redlined.

proposal.summary: Add a standalone Company right to terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice, limit HDI's termination to the end of the then-current term, and cap the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3 amounts.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standalone Company right to terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice (so the exit is not read as mere non-renewal) and limited HDI's Section 4.1 termination to the end of the then-current term, and we have capped the Termination Payment at three months of the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.

ops.text: The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time for convenience, with or without cause, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to HDI. Any termination by HDI under this Section 4.1 shall be effective only at the end of the then-current term, and any Termination Date specified in HDI's notice shall be the last day of that term.
In no event shall the Termination Payment exceed the amounts payable by the Company to HDI under Section 3 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.
